periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of each patch is oriented at approximately 75 to 85 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, tilting inward toward the sagittal plane at the superior margin.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical axis is approximately twice the length of the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a significant downward taper, with the lowest point narrowing and shifting medially toward the snout relative to the wider superior section.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are positioned at the lateral extremes of the cranium with an inter-ear gap approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Generally semi-circular but exhibiting high-frequency textural irregularity due to dense fur, resulting in a non-smooth, fringed boundary profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible manipulation of a bamboo culm by the forelimb in the lower foreground; significant ochre-colored staining in the fur of the submental and ventral neck regions.
